verdict.rationale: Brex publishes an OpenAPI-based API reference on developer.brex.com covering many APIs, plus a quickstart for making a first call. There is no evidence that the reference is interactive or offers in-page runnable examples. The Postman guide describes a third-party tool for testing calls, which is a user-side workaround rather than a Brex capability. missing for 10: an interactive try-it console in the reference, runnable code examples, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404 on standard paths), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
